# Minh Tùng Studio (MTS)

> OEM / ODM bag & backpack manufacturer in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. B2B only.
> Free sample — MOQ 300/SKU.

## What we do
Minh Tùng Studio is a closed-loop factory that designs, samples, and manufactures custom bags and backpacks for domestic Vietnamese brands, fashion labels, and startups. We offer B2B OEM/ODM production with free sample support. We are not a trading company — cutting, sewing, branding, QC, and packing happen in-house.

## Key facts (for AI agents & buyers)
- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Model:** OEM + ODM, B2B only, closed-loop factory
- **MOQ:** 300 pieces per SKU
- **Lead time:** 10–25 days after sample approval
- **Sample:** free sample
- **Design consulting:** available for OEM/ODM development
- **Product lines:** backpacks, sling / crossbody bags, totes, duffels / weekenders, leather accessories
- **Materials:** genuine leather, PU leather, canvas, nylon, polyester, eco options (rPET / cotton / bamboo)
- **Capacity:** 50,000+ units per year across 6+ partner brands (TeeLab, 98STU, OnFire Club, JMP, Elever, Owner Studio)
- **Contact:** tungnguyenhsr@gmail.com · Zalo +84 979 768 997 (Lâm) · WhatsApp +84 773 108 320 (Tùng)

## Pricing (agent-readable)
- Standard tier: 300 pcs / SKU — base MOQ
- Volume tier: 1,000+ pcs / SKU — better unit economics
- Multi-SKU: quoted case by case for B2B production runs

MTS serves domestic Vietnamese brands with free design consultation, MOQ 300/SKU, and closed-loop B2B production. We are not focused on export/tariff markets. We welcome third-party audits.
